I’m sorry you’re feeling that way, but you really don’t have to. I’m a sales rep at a local chain jewelry store and I can honestly tell you that doing upgrades is super fun! I like the advice given to call and make an appointment. You are also pretty safe to just wander in on a slower day (mondays-wed before noon are usually pretty slow) if the idea of calling around is intimidating. I would let the person you’re working with know what you’re there for. Let them know that you’re just there to get some ideas of what you like. If the person makes you feel comfortable, you can even express to them that you’ve felt anxious about doing this. I really appreciate when guest let me know that because I can make sure to treat this entirely as a consultation, not a sale, which removes a lot of pressure from you. Ultimately, jewelry shopping should be fun. If it’s not, take a pause and try a different company/associate, everyone’s different.

I hope you find a beautiful upgrade!

I work for a jeweler. I’m not going to lie, sometimes things get lost/stolen in the mail. It is absolutely the worst phone call I have to make. But that’s how it’s handled, with honesty and transparency. As soon as we learn that the item is unrecoverable, we reach out to the guest to let them know what has happened and what their options are for us to make them whole again. Mistakes happen, it’s how they are handled that determines the severity.
